description:
The scavengers working the freight lane aren't organised, not dangerous in a group, and not, strictly, anybody's responsibility. That's precisely why the job pays fifty and comes with a packet of rad pills.

Nobody makes a speech about this one. Somebody points at the freight lane, says a number, and goes back to what they were doing.
name: Pest Control

objectives.desc: Cull 2 Desperate Scavengers: the freight lane past the yards, or the red flats further out
emotes: {who} clears the freight lane the way you clear a gutter, without ceremony.
{who} puts down a scavenger who was probably three weeks out of a vat.
